question: {Simplify}: (3x + 7)² - (3x - 7)²
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use the formula for difference of squares: a² − b² = (a − b)(a + b).

Here: a = (3x + 7), b = (3x − 7).

Substitute: (3x + 7 − (3x − 7))(3x + 7 + (3x − 7)).

Simplify: (14)(6x) = 84x.

∴ Answer = 8
